resources.string: Upload files to an HTTP/HTTPS endpoint
Enter an HTTP or HTTPS upload URL first.
Choose at least one file first.
Folder uploads send each file with its relative path in the form field "relative_path". The server must support this convention to rebuild folders.

Choose FileUploader from a compatible app's upload flow, then select files or a folder. Selected items are returned to the calling app. Folder paths are preserved only when the calling app and website support directory uploads.
